sections.appearance: She has silver, wavy hair slighly below shoulder-length with bangs tied to a ponytail, accompanied with a black cross hair clip. She has dark olive eyes. Halo ==== Hare's halo is a tri-section yellow circle, with three different sized black circles with three yellow circles within. Uniform ==== She wears a white lab coat with black rims, sleeve patches and buttons with a Millennium access badge tucked in the pocket, with black and olive hoodie underneath covering her black shorts, alongside a green belt and a yellow Veritas logo badge on the collar. She also wears black shoes with olive rim and her firearm attached to her lab coat. For her pajamas, Hare wears a simple, oversized dark navy blue long-sleeved nightshirt with a small graphic text printed on the upper left chest. She wears light gray slip-on sandals with three white horizontal stripes on the straps. She is seen holding a very long, beanbag-style green body pillow that wraps behind her onto the floor. Her silver hair is left untied and messy, and she retains her distinctive yellow halo above her head. Firearm ==== thumb|Auto Aimer|150px She uses a two tone Kel Tec RFB bullpup rifle with a white three point sling, upper receiver and handguard. The lower receiver, trigger group, and barrel is painted black. The Millennium's name and insignia is imprinted on the handguard while the Veritas' name is stamped on the stock.

sections.personality: Compared to the other Veritas members, Hare is the second most reserved of them. Hare prefers centering her focus on improving her assistant bots instead of causing mischief. Despite her ability and achievements, she doesn't go bragging about it. She often pulls all-nighters and has developed a dependence on high-caffeine energy drinks as a result. If she is cut off from her supply, her withdrawal symptoms often prove debilitating.
